title: Modal First Aid
story: A release file still begins with DRAFT=true. The deploy bot has interpreted this as a thoughtful request to do absolutely nothing.
objective: Remove the first line from /workspace/release.env while preserving the SERVICE and LOG_LEVEL lines and the file's mode 640.
hints: Use vi release.env to edit the virtual file. Type help vi first if modal editing is new to you.
vi starts in Normal mode with the cursor on the first line. The dd command deletes the current line.
After deleting the draft line, type :wq and press Enter to save and quit.
explanation: vi separates navigation commands from inserted text. In Normal mode, dd removes the current line; :wq writes the changed buffer to the virtual file and quits. The validator checks the resulting content and mode, so another safe route that produces the same file also works.
